name: omarchy-lab
title_zh: 临时虚拟机里改代码，改完即弃不留痕
tagline_zh: 在 Omarchy Lab 的一次性虚拟机里做分支部署、打检查点、截屏调试。改完即弃，不污染你的宿主环境。
tagline_en: Branch-deploy, checkpoint, screenshot, and debug inside Omarchy Lab's disposable VM. Changes vanish when.
desc_en: Operate Omarchy Lab's disposable VM for guest-side development, branch deployment, checkpoints, screenshots, and debugging. Use when the user asks to use or test in Lab; do not redirect ordinary host customization or replace the Omarchy ISO acceptance harness.
why_zh: 把开发环境做成一次性消耗品：每次操作从干净快照起步，失败就扔，不积累脏状态。比手动清理虚拟机可靠。
why_en: Treats dev env as consumable: each run starts from a clean snapshot, failures are discarded, no state buildup. More faithful.
limit_zh: 只管 Lab 里的 guest 侧开发与调试，不接管宿主机的日常定制，也不替代 Omarchy ISO 验收流程。
limit_en: Only handles guest-side dev/debug inside Lab. Won't customize your host or replace ISO acceptance. Requires existing Lab access and sufficient VM.
title_en: Throwaway VM for guest-side dev & debug
